description: Describe what a manufacturing process can hold: minimum wall thickness, minimum hole-to-edge and hole-to-bend distances, minimum internal corner radius, bend radius, draft angle, pocket depth-to-width ratio. Call process_feasibility to test one measured feature against these. These are published rules of thumb for geometric feasibility, not a specific shop's capability, and they say nothing about cost or lead time.
name: process_limits
title: Manufacturing Process Limits
